wrong_extinguisher_banner: Wrong extinguisher! It won't work on this fire.
prompt_lesson: Tap the floor to begin the lesson
prompt_place_wall_content: Tap a wall to mount the alarm and extinguishers
prompt_place_fire: Tap the floor to start the fire
prompt_scan_wall: Move your phone slowly to scan the wall…
prompt_scan_floor: Move your phone slowly to scan the floor…
activate_alarm: Activate: find and tap the manual call point to raise the alarm
scanning_floor: Scanning the room for a floor…
mount_extinguishers: Tap a wall to mount the extinguishers
choose_extinguisher_default: Choose the correct extinguisher for this fire
guide_class_a: Class A fire (ordinary combustibles) — use the GREY extinguisher
guide_class_bc: Class B/C fire (liquid or electrical) — use the YELLOW extinguisher. Never the grey one — it's not safe here
guide_class_abc: Multi-class fire — the RED (ABC-rated) extinguisher is safest
pass_aim_base: Aim at the base of the fire
pass_squeeze: Press and hold the handle to spray
pass_sweep: Sweep side to side while spraying
pass_keep_spraying: Keep spraying until the fire is out
wrong_extinguisher_warning_line: ⚠ Wrong extinguisher — this won't put out this fire!
check_gas_shutoff: Shut off the gas supply before the fire is extinguished
check_extinguisher_class: Choose the correct extinguisher for this fire class
cert_enter_name_prompt: Enter your name and tap Generate.
cert_verify_invalid: ✗ INVALID — this text was not issued by this app, or has been altered.
scenario_trashcan: A fire just started in a trash can! What should you do?
scenario_outlet: A fire just started at an overloaded power outlet! What should you do?
scenario_cabinet: A fire just started in the electrical cabinet! What should you do?
scenario_furnace: A fire just started at the gas furnace! What should you do?
proximity_warning: Step back! Don't stand within 4 ft. of the fire.
